trust_decision.summary: An untrusted identity name must be RFC4515-escaped before it is substituted into the operator-configured LDAP user filter; the decision is made where the search request is built, in ldap.Client.GetUser (lib/server/ldap/client.go:175), and the published fix adds ldap.EscapeFilter(fix.diff:72).

landing_point.why: The advisory names an unescaped username in the 'GetUser filter'; this is the only place in the tree that builds an LDAP search filter, and it interpolates the caller-supplied username into lc.UserFilter with Sprintf.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /enroll (Basic-auth username) -> serverrequestcontext.go:107 -> user.Registry.GetUser; also /register, /identities and /revoke
ldap.Client.GetUser (testability seam: new Connection interface + AdminConn field type change)
ldap.Client.newConnection, used by GetUser and user.Login
fix_sites.module_kind: connection/transport (ldap.Dial -> ldap.DialURL cleanup, not part of the injection fix)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: n/a - there is no O2 site and no O8 route: lib/server/ldap/client.go:172-178 is the only LDAP filter construction in the tree and every identity route funnels into it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The filter template itself is legitimate filter syntax (default '(uid=%s)' at lib/server/ldap/client.go:111, operator-supplied templates may be compound like '(|(uid=%s)(mail=%s))'); escaping the formatted filter or the template instead of only the substituted username escapes the filter's own parentheses and '=' and breaks every LDAP lookup.

O6_input_shapes: plain username string from HTTP Basic authentication (/enroll)
username taken from a URL path segment and from JSON body fields name/ID (/identities, /register)
filter metacharacters * ( ) \ and NUL, plus bytes > 0x7f, all escaped by ldap.EscapeFilter (vendor/github.com/go-ldap/ldap/v3/ldap.go:317-345)
multi-character injection payloads such as '*)(uid=*' built from the same metacharacters

O7_producer.where: lib/serverrequestcontext.go:91 (username decoded from the authorization header) and lib/serveridentities.go:363 (URL path variable)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a group/affiliation search that interpolates the affiliation name into the GroupFilter template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Config.GroupFilter is defined and defaulted (lib/server/ldap/client.go:38,112) but never used because GetAffiliation returns errNotSupported, and the FVT payload ships groups.ldif (images/fabric-ca-fvt/payload/slapd_setup.sh:42); a maintainer implementing LDAP affiliations would copy GetUser's filter construction.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GetFilteredUsers doing a paged search with the requested affiliation/types interpolated into a filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the method is stubbed next to GetUser, so filling it in is a natural follow-up and repeats the same Sprintf-into-filter pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a DN- or attribute-based user lookup (search by entry DN or mail) added beside the enrollmentID lookup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GetUser is already called with ctx.enrollmentID from the authenticated certificate, so a maintainer adding a subject/attribute search would add a second filter site rather than change GetUser.

O9_family: LDAP injection (CWE-90): user-controlled identity name interpolated into an LDAP search filter without RFC4515 escaping

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.0 with toolchain go1.26.3 (go.mod:3-5); dependencies vendored in vendor/ so 'go build -mod=vendor' and the Makefile targets work offline
services: live LDAP server (OpenLDAP/slapd on localhost:10389) for the ldap package's own tests
O10_build.project_tests: lib/server/ldap/client_test.go:17-21 (TestLDAP) needs a running OpenLDAP at localhost:10389 and is therefore listed as an exclusion in scripts/run_unit_tests:9-12 at the pinned commit; only NewClient/config-string tests run offline. The fix's new tests (fix.diff:161-225, plus fix.diff:230-236 removing the /ldap exclusion) rely on a Connection stub that does not exist at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: ldap.EscapeFilter(fmt.Sprintf(lc.UserFilter, username)) (or escaping/stripping in the HTTP handlers), which escapes the filter template's own syntax and makes every LDAP lookup return no match.

out_of_scope_notes: The same commit also replaces ldap.Dial/DialTLS with ldap.DialURL (fix.diff:81-98) and renames two testify calls in unrelated tests; neither closes an injection site and neither was pursued.
unverified: O1=5 counts distinct HTTP endpoints (/enroll, /register, /identities, /identities/{id}, /revoke); there are 7 distinct method+path calls (POST /identities, GET/PUT/DELETE /identities/{id} plus the four others) at lib/serveridentities.go:27,37,238,293,346,373 and lib/serverrevoke.go:136, all converging on the single GetUser sink.
j_multi_site=1 follows the stated O1>=2 rule; in reality only one code site needs the check, since all entry points pass through lib/server/ldap/client.go:175.
single_site is applied to the injection fix (GetUser) only; the same commit also rewrites newConnection and adds the Connection interface, neither of which creates a second injection site.
